input.question: besides the dollar amount, what the hell are autioneers actually saying?
input.ground_truth: It doesn't really matter what they're saying. The point is to get you psyched up and excited so you're more prone to buying something. All about energy levels moreso than actual content. If you go to some auctions for more expensive items (luxury cars, art, etc.), then you'll probably hear a slower auctioneer and a more thorough description of the item.

Question: besides the dollar amount, what the hell are autioneers actually saying?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you and your friends are playing a game where you all want the same shiny toy. An "auctioneer" is the person who helps everyone decide who gets the toy. But instead of just picking someone, they make everyone shout out how much they want the toy by saying numbers (that’s the dollar amount).

But the auctioneer isn’t just saying the numbers. They’re also saying other things to help the game go smoothly and make it exciting! They might say things like:

- “Do I hear more?” (Are you going to say a bigger number?)
- “Sold!” (Someone got the toy!)
- “One more time!” (Let’s try again!)
- “Going once, going twice…” (This is your last chance to say a bigger number!)

So, besides the numbers, the auctioneer is telling everyone what to do next and making the game fun and fair.
